prompt: Create a new FRONT orthographic edge-elevation for the Iron Stations platform edge segment. Use the FIRST reference (the accepted REAR view of this same object) as the exact target world-Z support-frame height and broad X width: the new FRONT support posts and X-brace must be equally tall, not half-height. Use the SECOND reference (the approved thin-tactile FRONT candidate) for the thin yellow tactile rim and the correct FRONT edge material/plane; do not copy its too-short support frame. Keep the tactile strip edge-on as a narrow yellow horizontal band, with no broad gray tiled floor surface. Show the same full-width dark iron support arrangement and cross-bracing reaching down to the same bottom line as the accepted REAR. True axis-aligned side elevation, no perspective, no top view. Transparent background and full object. Inferred view.

reference_inputs.role: accepted same-object geometry and target common support height/width
approved front tactile rim and material plane only; support frame was too short

geometry_constraints: match REAR support height and width
